svg.text: Experiment: DFly2-style shared-KV MTP drafter for Bonsai 2.5 at 100K context
qwen38-engine, GTX 1070 Ti (sm_61, 7373 MiB cap), Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B PTQ1_0 + built-in Q4_0 MTP head (blk.64).
Solid boxes and bars = measured in PR #69; hatched blue = new component or estimate.
A. Today: one 102021-token ChatML request, MTP built-in head, 2 steps (measured, raw/real_b25mtp_s2_c102400)
48 Gated DeltaNet layers: fixed-size state (no KV growth)
16 GQA layers (3, 7, ..., 63): 24 q / 4 kv heads, d 256
iso3 KV: 800 B per position per layer
KV cache 16 layers x 102400 positions = 1250.0 MiB (VRAM)
MTP block (blk.64): its OWN attention and its OWN KV cache
VRAM does not fit at ctx 102400 -> engine log "MTP block: CPU"
MTP prefill over the whole prompt on the CPU: 4395.7 s
Draft: CPU attention over 102K own positions: 32.3 s / 113 = 286 ms per cycle
Own KV at 102400: 1 layer x 800 B x 102400 = 78.1 MiB
Verify (target, T = 1 + drafts): 21.1 s / 113 cycles = 187 ms per cycle
time to first token 6709.5 s (111.8 min)
time to first token 2522.4 s (42.0 min)
draft 22.9 ms + verify 100.0 ms per cycle
B. Proposal: the drafter reads the target's layer-63 KV at a few selected positions (KV share + index share)
runs anyway in every verify step
iso3 K/V cache index 15 (already in VRAM)
NEW sideband: per kv head, max score
from the drafter's own k/v projection)
reads about 2180 x 800 B = 1.7 MB per
draft token at ANY context length
no drafter KV cache (-78.1 MiB at 102400)
100K: CPU (RAM is free: RSS 0.8 GB of 14.2)
only q (24 KB) up and attn out (24 KB)

CPU FFN read 228 MB per draft at
Why training is needed (and what DFly2 does differently)
Today the MTP keys come from the MTP's own k_proj on (embedding, last hidden). Layer-63 keys come from layer 63's k_proj on its own input:
a different space, so the current head cannot read them as is (phase 0 measures how bad zero-shot is). DFly2 initializes each draft layer
from its paired target layer and trains with the shared KV. Here: retrain blk.64 attention on layer-63 K/V with tools/bonsai_mtp_train
(live teacher on Colab RTX PRO 6000; the teacher forward already produces layer-63 K/V). DFly2 targets are natively sparse (indexer per layer);
Qwen3.8 GQA has no indexer, so the selection is a block-max sideband computed in our own attention kernel (an assumption to verify in phase 0).
C. Time per MTP cycle at 102K (1 px = 0.8 ms)
no MTP: 106.9 ms per token = 9.36 tok/s (measured)
verify ~151 ms = 100 ms (verify at ctx 4096, measured) + 51 ms (attention cost at 102K for one query row: 1/9.36 - 1/17.9 s). Today a 3-row verify pays ~87 ms of attention.
D. VRAM at ctx 102400 (1 px = 10 MiB, cap 7373 MiB)
MTP block on GPU, own KV
E. Plan, each phase ends at a measured gate (stop or continue)
